title: .5 Short-term rental
text:
20.02.870.5 Short-term rental.
"Short-term rental" means any residential use, including a single-family home, duplex, an accessory structure, or a unit in an apartment/multifamily residential building, mixed-use residential building, or condominium building, or any portion thereof, used for lodging accommodations to occupants for a period of less than thirty consecutive days.
1.	A short-term rental does not include a bed and breakfast.
2.	The zoning standard for the base residential use shall apply to the short-term rental.
(Ord. No. 019840, § I, 2-3-2026)
